summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of calendar appointment scheduling with new German fields (Sachverständiger, Ansprechpartner, date ranges). All requested features working correctly in demo mode.

New appointment modal opens with 'Neuer Termin' button
Date range fields (Datum Von/Datum Bis) positioned at top in highlighted section
Zuständiger Sachverständiger field present with correct label and placeholder
Ansprechpartner field present with correct label and placeholder
Appointment creation with all new fields successful
Calendar displays Sachverständiger and Ansprechpartner info on appointments
Calendar shows date range (07.04 – 09.04) when start_date differs from end_date
UI responsiveness and field positioning correct
